verdict.rationale: Missive is a SaaS team-inbox platform, so an official CLI is a fair question, but the evidence never documents one. The REST API, MCP server and webhooks are developer building blocks or a different capability. The in-app ⌘/Ctrl+K command bar is a UI feature, not a command-line tool. None of these earn credit toward an official CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
